scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A finite-entropy separation of microstates and nonmicrostates free entropy” (preprints/A-finite-entropy-separation-of-microstates-and-nonmicrostates-free-entropy-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 298 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab386b728e4dff53), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist an integer n ≥ 2 and a bounded self-adjoint tuple X = (X1, . . . , Xn) in a von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state such that −∞ < χ(X) ≤ χ∗ (X) − 1 2 < ∞. Here χ is the original microstates entropy using an operator-norm cutoff and a limsup over matrix sizes.
